summary: Kerb lined with parked cars, wooded bank behind, no homes opposite.
reasons: Row of cars parks here already
Dorms 36 m or more from east end

best_section.where: eastern end of the south kerb, among the parked cars before the barrier arm

drivers.seclusion: Dense trees behind the kerb; nearest mapped dorms 17 m, 36 m and 46 m away, all measured at the western start. Lawn and oval opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Public road with a continuous row of parked cars, so a van fits in line.
drivers.traffic: Campus access road, moderate traffic; the parked van stands outside the lane.
drivers.convention: A dozen cars park along this kerb, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Paid mapped car park 90 m away
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from the south and west bank; open to the north.
